answer: The bridge detector writes to marble, and trellis shows every merge. Submissions that land within 267 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, as a result the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 222 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
